title: Property Tax Bill
description: A county property tax statement: the taxing authority, the property and its owner, assessed values and levy rates, amounts due, past-due amounts, and the breakdown of tax by taxing district.

taxing_authority.description: The office that issued the bill and receives payment.

name.description: Name of the issuing office, e.g. the county treasurer.

payment_remit_address.description: Mailing address payments are sent to, from the payment coupon.

tax_year.description: The tax year the statement is for, as printed in the statement title.

escrow_company.description: Escrow or mortgage company paying the taxes, or NONE as printed.

property_type.description: Property type, e.g. REAL PROPERTY or PERSONAL PROPERTY.

legal_description.description: Abbreviated legal description of the parcel.

tax_area.description: Tax area code identifying the levy area.

tax_paid_prior_year.description: Total tax paid in the prior year, in dollars.

value_information.description: Assessed value and levy rate by year, one entry per row of the value table.

percent_change.description: Percent change in value from the prior year, as a number (9.17 for 9.17%). Null if not printed.

levy_rate.description: Levy rate exactly as printed, with all decimal places.

amounts_due.description: The account summary of amounts due.

due_date.description: Date the first-half payment is due, as printed.

past_due_details.description: Past-due amounts by year, one entry per row.

year.description: Year label as printed, e.g. 2025 or 2023 & Prior.

taxes_fees_assessments.description: Unpaid taxes, fees and assessments, in dollars.

district_taxes.description: Current-year tax and assessment detail, one entry per taxing district.

district.description: Name of the taxing district or assessment.

tax_amount.description: Tax amount for that district, in dollars.

voter_approved_tax_amount.description: Voter-approved tax amount, in dollars, from the note under the district detail.
